key_provisions_or_claims: Class 1 misdemeanor for knowingly flying a UAS within 50 feet of a dwelling to harass, or after notice to desist.
Misdemeanor for violating FAA security restrictions or dropping items/imaging inmates at correctional facilities.
Class 4 felony for unauthorized UAS entry over utilities, critical infrastructure or maritime facilities.
Exemptions for consent, FAA-authorized lawful operation, and employees on official business.
Class 4 felony for imaging controlled technical information at contracted defense facilities; operators immune when repelling UAS.
annotation.summary_en: Virginia Code § 18.2-121.3 criminalizes trespass with an unmanned aircraft system: flying near dwellings to harass, violating FAA security restrictions, interfering with correctional facilities, and unauthorized flights over critical infrastructure or defense facilities, with exemptions for consent and FAA-compliant operation. Amended through 2025.
